description: Look up a Berachain transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in BERA, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use bera_receipt, for emitted events bera_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x19db8c305092673a73e777b690469a0962145d4289a2608e8f62881c3a9ac18a. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: bera_tx
title: Berachain transaction
